page:
Vite plugin API guide for extending Rolldown's plugin interface with Vite-specific options. Write plugins once for dev and build.
- Plugin authoring: check Features guide and community plugins before creating
- Inline plugins in vite.config.js, no need for separate package
- vite-plugin-inspect: inspect intermediate plugin state at localhost:5173/__inspect/
- Rolldown plugin documentation recommended first read
- Compatible Rollup plugins: implement as Vite plugins if meeting criteria
- Rolldown Plugin naming: 'rolldown-plugin-' prefix, include 'rolldown-plugin' and 'vite-plugin' keywords
- Vite-only plugin naming: 'vite-plugin-' prefix, include 'vite-plugin' keyword
- Framework-specific: 'vite-plugin-vue-', 'vite-plugin-react-', 'vite-plugin-svelte-' prefixes
- Plugin config: devDependencies, plugins array option
- Falsy plugins ignored (easy activation/deactivation)
- Plugin presets: multiple plugins as single element, flattened internally
- Factory function pattern: return plugin object, accept options for customization
- Hook filters (Rolldown feature): filter pattern for performance, backward compatible
- Rolldown hooks: options, buildStart, resolveId, load, transform, buildEnd, closeBundle
- Vite-specific hooks: config, configResolved, configureServer, configurePreviewServer, closeServer, closePreviewServer, transformIndexHtml, handleHotUpdate
- Vite hooks types: async, sequential, parallel kinds
- Plugin context meta: this.meta.viteVersion
- Per-environment hooks: resolveId, load, transform (all per-environment)
- Global hooks: config, configResolved, configureServer, configurePreviewServer, etc.
- Path normalization: POSIX separators (/) for id comparisons
- normalizePath utility from 'vite' module
- Virtual modules convention: 'virtual:' prefix, \0 encoding
- Hook filter feature: Rolldown/Rollup 4.38.0+ and Vite 6.3.0+
- @rolldown/pluginutils: createFilter, exactRegex, prefixRegex exports
- Output bundle metadata: viteMetadata.importedCss, viteMetadata.importedAssets
- Asset emission: this.emitFile({ type: 'asset', ... }), import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_<id>
- CSS/HTML tokens: __VITE_ASSET__<id>__ for non-JS positions
- Plugin ordering: enforce 'pre'/'post' properties
- Conditional application: apply property for 'serve' or 'build' command
- Chunk import map (experimental): build.chunkImportMap option
- importmap.json: import map output file
- Server to client: server.ws.send, hot.on event listeners
- Client to server: hot.send, server.ws.on event listeners
- Custom event typing: CustomEventMap interface extension
- Rolldown compatibility: moduleParsed hook not used, doesn't rely on specific options

sections.manifest:
Plugin authoring best practices.
- Check Features guide for existing solutions
- Review community plugins: Rollup compatible and Vite-specific
- vite-plugin-inspect: debug plugin state at localhost:5173/__inspect__/
- Read Rolldown plugin documentation first
- Inline plugins in vite.config.js (no separate package needed initially)
- Share plugins after validation
How do I start authoring a Vite plugin?

Plugin naming conventions.
- Compatible Rolldown plugins: 'rolldown-plugin-' prefix, include 'rolldown-plugin' and 'vite-plugin' keywords
- Vite-only plugins: 'vite-plugin-' prefix, include 'vite-plugin' keyword, document why Vite-only
- Framework-specific: 'vite-plugin-vue-', 'vite-plugin-react-', 'vite-plugin-svelte-' prefixes
- Exposes plugins to broader ecosystem
How do I name my Vite plugin?

Plugin configuration and usage.
- plugins: devDependencies
- plugins array in config
- Falsy plugins: ignored for easy activation/deactivation
- Plugin presets: return array of plugins, flattened internally
- Factory function pattern: accept options for customization
How do I configure and use plugins?

Simple plugin examples.
- Transforming custom file types: fileRegex pattern, transform hook with filter and handler
- Return { code, map }
- Importing virtual files: exactRegex, virtual module ID, resolveId filter, load filter
- __VITE_ASSET__<id>__ encoding during dev as /@id/__x00__<id>
- Decoded before plugin hooks
How do I create simple plugins?

Rolldown build hooks.
- Called during dev by plugin container
- Per-environment hooks: resolveId, load, transform
- Server start hooks: options, buildStart
- Module request hooks: resolveId, load, transform
- Server close hooks: buildEnd, closeBundle
- moduleParsed: not called in dev (Vite avoids full AST parses)
- Output generation hooks: not called in dev (except closeBundle)
- importer value: may be absolute path for generic index.html
- SSR-specific plugin logic available
What Rolldown hooks are available?

Vite-specific plugin hooks.
- config: modify Vite config before resolution, async/sequential/global, return partial or mutate
- configResolved: read final resolved config, async/parallel/global, store config for later use
- configureServer: configure dev server, async/sequential/global, add middlewares, store server instance
- Post middleware: return function called after internal middlewares
- configurePreviewServer: configure preview server, async/sequential/global, same as configureServer
- closeServer: called on restart or close, async/parallel/global, dispose resources, reason: 'restart'/'close'
- closePreviewServer: preview only, async/parallel/global, no reason parameter
- transformIndexHtml: transform HTML entry (index.html), async/sequential/per-environment
- Receives HTML string and context
- Return: transformed HTML, tag descriptors, or object with both
- order: 'pre'/'post' for hook timing
- Tag injectTo: 'head', 'body', 'head-prepend', 'body-prepend'
- handleHotUpdate: custom HMR update handling, async/sequential/per-environment
- Receives HmrContext with file, timestamp, modules, read(), server
- Can filter modules, return empty array for full reload or custom HMR
What Vite-specific hooks are available?

Plugin context metadata.
- this.meta.viteVersion: Vite version string (e.g., '8.0.0')
- this.meta.rolldownVersion: Rolldown version (Rolldown-powered Vite only, e.g., Vite 8+)
- Detect Rolldown-powered Vite for conditional logic
What metadata is available in plugin context?

Output bundle metadata (build).
- Rolldown augments output with Vite-specific viteMetadata
- Available in: RenderedChunk, OutputChunk, OutputAsset
- Fields: viteMetadata.importedCss (Set<string>), viteMetadata.importedAssets (Set<string>)
- Use in renderChunk, generateBundle, writeBundle hooks
- Inspect emitted CSS and assets without relying on build.manifest
How do I access output bundle metadata?

Referencing emitted assets from plugins.
- this.emitFile({ type: 'asset', name, source }): returns referenceId
- JavaScript: import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_<referenceId> expression
- Append query/hash with string concatenation
- CSS/HTML: __VITE_ASSET__<referenceId>__ token
- Append query/hash right after token
How do I emit assets from plugins?

Plugin ordering and conditional application.
- enforce: 'pre'/'post' property for plugin order
- Order: Alias → pre-enforce plugins → Vite core → no-enforce → build plugins → post-enforce → post-build plugins
- Separate from hook ordering (hook order attribute as usual)
- apply: 'build'/'serve' for conditional application
- Function form: apply(config, { command }) for precise control
- return command === 'build' && !config.build.ssr
How do I order plugins and apply them conditionally?

Rolldown/Rollup plugin compatibility.
- Vite plugins work with Rolldown/Rollup plugins if:
- Not using moduleParsed hook
- Not relying on Rolldown-specific options (transform.inject)
- No tight coupling between bundle-phase and output-phase hooks
- Build-only plugins: specify under build.rolldownOptions.plugins
- Works like Vite plugin with enforce: 'post' and apply: 'build'
- Augment existing plugins with Vite properties using spread syntax
How do I ensure Rolldown/Rollup plugin compatibility?

Path normalization for plugins.
- Vite normalizes to POSIX separators (/) with volume in Windows
- Rollup keeps paths untouched (win32 separators in Windows)
- normalizePath utility from 'vite' module
- normalizes to POSIX separators
- Use before comparing paths against resolved ids
- Rollup plugins use @rollup/pluginutils normalizePath internally
How do I normalize paths in plugins?

Hook filters for performance.
- Rolldown hook filter feature: specify patterns for hook invocation
- Reduces communication overhead between Rust and JavaScript
- Supported in Rollup 4.38.0+ and Vite 6.3.0+
- @rolldown/pluginutils: createFilter, exactRegex, prefixRegex
- Also available from rolldown/filter
- Backward compatible: check inside hook handler too
- Example: transform hook with filter { id: /\.js$/ }
How do hook filters improve performance?

Chunk import map information (experimental).
- build.chunkImportMap option: use unique ID for each chunk instead of file path
- Import map output: chunk ID to file path mapping
- Access in generateBundle or writeBundle hooks
- Import map name: build.rolldownOptions.experimental.chunkImportMap.fileName (defaults to 'importmap.json')
- Parse as JSON from bundle
How do I access chunk import map information?

Client-server communication in plugins.
- Server to client: server.ws.send, hot.on on client
- Client to server: hot.send, server.ws.on on server
- Prefix event names to avoid collisions
- Client-side usage: if (import.meta.hot) guard
- Custom event typing: extend CustomEventMap interface in .d.ts
- import 'vite/types/customEvent.d.ts'
- InferCustomEventPayload<T> for type inference
How do I implement server-client communication?

Virtual modules convention.
- Virtual module ID prefix: 'virtual:'
- Resolved ID: \0 prepended (encoded as /@id/__x00__ in dev)
- exactRegex utility for precise matching
- Load handler returns module code
- Client-side: normal ESM import syntax
